plugin.note: Bears have negligible Defence and low Hitpoints, so any melee weapon clears them instantly; a Dragon scimitar or better is more than enough. They carry a fire spell weakness (grizzly 20%, black 30%) if training Magic. Krystilia's task must be done in the Wilderness with risk-appropriate gear.

requirements: No Slayer level is required; only 13 combat is needed to receive the task.
Grizzly bear cubs in Isafdar require partial completion of Regicide to reach.
Krystilia's bears must be killed in the Wilderness.
mechanics: Bears attack with slash and have no offensive threat at low levels.
Grizzly bears are aggressive; black bears are not.
Grizzly bears have a 20% fire spell weakness and black bears a 30% fire spell weakness (June 2025).

methods.label: Melee
methods.summary: Kill any counting bear with any melee weapon; they die in one or two hits.
requiredOrKeyItems: Any melee weapon (Dragon scimitar or better)
steps: For starter masters, go to the Fremennik Province woods outside Rellekka or the Mind Altar black bears.
For Krystilia, kill grizzly bears in the Wilderness west of the Graveyard of Shadows with risk-appropriate gear.
Attack with any melee weapon until the task completes.

methods.label: Wilderness (Krystilia) safe kit
methods.summary: Complete the Krystilia task in the low-level Wilderness with cheap, risk-appropriate gear to minimise PKer loss.
requiredOrKeyItems: Cheap melee weapon and armour you can afford to lose
steps: Bank valuables; wear only risk-appropriate gear before entering the Wilderness.
Kill grizzly bears west of the Graveyard of Shadows; they die in one or two hits.
Watch the minimap for PKers and teleport out when threatened.

body:
# Bears

Bears (black bears, bear cubs, grizzly bears, grizzly bear cubs, reanimated bears, and Callisto) are a trivial low-level Slayer task assigned by Krystilia, Turael, Spria, and Mazchna. They have negligible Defence and low Hitpoints, so any melee weapon works. Starter-master tasks are fastest at the Fremennik Province woods outside Rellekka or the Mind Altar black bears; Krystilia's task must be done in the low-level Wilderness west of the Graveyard of Shadows, so bring only risk-appropriate gear.
